paper_id.description: Stable blake3 hash from scientific-pdf-pipeline; primary key.

experiment_id.description: f'{paper_id}_{experiment_idx}' -- unique within this dataset build. Stable across repeated build-dataset runs against the same extracted_records.jsonl; NOT guaranteed stable across a full re-extraction (llm-extract run again), since experiment order is assigned by tier-bucketed cross-model matching, not fixed paper structure. For an ID that survives re-extraction, prefer (paper_id, evidence_location).

experiment_idx.description: Position of this experiment within its paper's experiments list (0-indexed).

n_experiments.description: Total experiments extracted from this row's paper (duplicated across all its experiment rows).

n_claims.description: Total causal/comparative claims extracted from this row's paper.

experiment_match_status.description: full_agreement | resolved_after_escalation | unresolved_conflict | single_model_only -- cross-model agreement status for THIS experiment specifically (distinct from the paper-level agreement_status).

match_method.description: identity_key | position -- how this experiment was paired across primary/cross_check/tie_breaker. 'position' means no unique catalyst-identity match was found; treat with extra scrutiny.

n_unresolved_experiment_fields.description: Count of fields within this experiment that no model majority could resolve.

evidence_location.description: Where in the source paper this experiment's data came from, e.g. 'Table 3, page 8'.

evidence_text.description: Verbatim supporting sentence/table row for this experiment, as quoted by the extracting model.

ml_core_features_complete.description: True only if every field in ['active_metal', 'support_type', 'metal_loading_wt_pct', 'reaction_temperature_C', 'reaction_pressure_bar', 'oil_conversion_pct'] is non-null for this experiment -- a ready-made filter for a shallow-ML structure-property-performance dataset. Null is not possible in practice (always True or False) but kept nullable for consistency with every other boolean column's not-reported-vs-false distinction.

feedstock_type.description: Lipid feedstock used in the paper
feedstock_type.title: Feedstock Type

ffa_content_pct.description: Free fatty acid content of the feedstock
ffa_content_pct.title: Ffa Content Pct

dominant_fatty_acid_chain.description: Dominant fatty-acid carbon-chain range reported for the feedstock (free text, e.g. "C16-C18"). Null if not reported.
dominant_fatty_acid_chain.title: Dominant Fatty Acid Chain

feedstock_sulfur_ppm.description: Sulfur content of the feedstock (catalyst-poison relevant)
feedstock_sulfur_ppm.title: Feedstock Sulfur Ppm

experiments.description: One entry per distinct catalyst/condition combination reported in the paper, NOT one entry per paper. If the paper tests 5 catalysts, this list must have 5 entries. Never merge, average, or discard rows to fit one entry.
experiments.title: Experiments

claims.description: Causal or comparative statements the paper makes about how a factor affects an outcome, independent of which specific experiment(s) support them.
claims.title: Claims

meets_density_spec.description: Density at 15°C <= 772 kg/m³ (ASTM D7566 Annex A2 SBC limit)

meets_viscosity_spec.description: Kinematic viscosity at -20°C <= 8.0 mm²/s (ASTM D7566 Annex A2)

meets_combustion_spec.description: Net heat of combustion >= 42.8 MJ/kg (ASTM D7566/D1655 minimum)
